_about: ack1: poses for Encounter's step 3 cue events, generated by render/anim/tools/wave_gen.mjs from render/anim/tools/waves/ack1.mjs. Played by AnimFighter (step 3 cues and ground contact). Render only, outside the sim's data hash.

ak.x_p.set._orig: a light being committed to: the body leans in a little, the near hand drawn back to set, the weight forward before the beat lets it go

ak.x_r.set._orig: a light being committed to, his way: the weight sits back a little, the shoulder turns, the chin stays up

ak.y_p.set._orig: a heavier blow being committed to: forward and patient, one shoulder wound back, the weight coming onto the front foot

ak.y_r.set._orig: a heavier blow being committed to, his way: the weight sunk back, the shoulder wound round, the chin up

ak.b_p.set._orig: the big press being committed to: sinking, the shoulders starting to wind, the head down on him

ak.b_r.set._orig: the big press being committed to, his way: sinking wide, the back starting to wind round, the chin level
